henchmenTypes.notes: The bulk of the warband. Bought in groups of 1-5.

Never use or need weapons/armour (chem-induced rage). Do not gain experience. May have Augmentations installed on recruitment only (Sub-Dermal Plating 10 tn; Frenzon Injector 10 tn, replenished 10 tn/battle; Enhanced Motive Actuators 15 tn = Sprint; Electrified Armaments 15 tn; Prey-Sight 15 tn) - each Augment after the second costs double. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules: Ordo Hereticus Retainers. Puritans to the Core / Burn the Witch: this warband hates the Mutant, the Witch and the Heretic, and may never hire any Xenos, Chaotic or Abhuman Hired Guns. Bolt Pistol and Hand Flamer are Heroes only. Min warband size 3, max 12. | Arco-Flagellants and Cyber-Mastiffs receive Augmentations (installed on recruitment only, never later; each Augment after the second costs double): Sub-Dermal Plating (6+ save that can never be ignored, 10 tn), Frenzon Injector (Frenzy and Hatred; replenished 10 tn after each battle, 10 tn), Enhanced Motive Actuators (counts as knowing Sprint, 15 tn), Electrified Armaments (wounds stun on 2-4 instead of 3-4, 15 tn), Prey-Sight (may always charge hidden models, 15 tn). | Human models use the standard Human maximum profile (TODO: verify vs v0.5). | TODO: verify Ecclesiastic Priest / Acolyte skill-table access - the p.042 checkmarks were ambiguous in the PDF extraction.
